description:
optional, enumerated string filter
The type of deduction. Possible values are : fixed_amount, percentage.
Supported operators : is, is_not, in, not_in

Example → discount_type[is] = "fixed_amount"

is.description: \* \`fixed_amount\` - The specified amount will be deducted. \* \`percentage\` - The specified percentage will be deducted. \* \`offer_quantity\` - The specified units will be offered without any deduction.

is_not.description: \* \`fixed_amount\` - The specified amount will be deducted. \* \`percentage\` - The specified percentage will be deducted. \* \`offer_quantity\` - The specified units will be offered without any deduction.
